source.title: Kinetic analysis
source.scope_limit: Thermo-mechanical analysis of one NbC-M2 HSS material family; no phosphor-furnace, semiconductor-production, or team-measured generalization claim.

facts: The workbooks supply temperature, time, and linear dimensional-change traces, not relative-density trajectories.
No per-run green density or final Archimedes density is supplied for a reversible shrinkage-to-density conversion.
The source supplies exact linear shrinkage trajectories for one material family.
The frozen input contract also requires green density and particle size, neither of which is bound to the downloadable run records.
The source contains thermo-mechanical curves but no initial or final grain-size measurements.
It provides no independently measured per-run growth-exponent target.
Heating-rate and isothermal schedules are experiments on one named material, not source-target production-batch transfers.
No paired batch property-drift vector or transfer-risk outcome is supplied.
The five constant-heating-rate curves can support a Kissinger analysis for one material family, but the frozen target requires independently labeled activation energy with a mechanism interval.

Curve points and rates from the same specimen family cannot be split as independent host-level activation-energy labels; fitting the target from the same curves would make the registered Kissinger baseline the label generator.
The source contains no XRD pattern, instrument metadata, candidate-phase list, calibrated phase fractions, or uncertainty intervals.

next_action: Retain the licensed curves for external research only; seek sources with exact record-bound density, green-state, grain, activation-energy, transfer-risk, or XRD uncertainty labels.
